Application Data.NAME: Creative Studio Innovations
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Creative Studio Innovations specializes in providing graphic design services, including branding, digital illustrations, and marketing materials for small businesses and startups. We operate primarily from a dedicated studio space that fosters creativity and collaboration while ensuring a secure environment for handling sensitive client projects. Our team employs industry-standard design software and maintains strict data backup protocols to protect our clients' information. Additionally, we conduct client workshops and training sessions on design principles in a safe and controlled manner.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 05/15/2023, a client reported a minor data loss due to a software malfunction affecting project files. The issue was resolved within 24 hours, and all necessary backups were restored. The estimated cost for recovery amounted to $1,200. The status of this loss is closed, with no ongoing implications for operations or client relationships.

Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security cameras monitoring the studio premises 24/7, along with a secure access control system for employee entry.
